actions.reason: K6_C0001 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (proliferation-high, oxidative-metabolism-low program; ER:0642ea974835:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:b8656a7616), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is unsupportive: set-versus-rest silhouettes are near zero across all four modalities with within/between distances nearly identical (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:b8656a7616), and the pair boundary with K6_C0003 is essentially zero in fused geometry (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:4003dcbb2e). No candidate-specific confounder is established (ER:0642ea974835:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:b8656a7616), and partition-wide technical associations remain broader context only (ER:0642ea974835:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:partition:e3b0c44298). Known-label correspondence is weak and contextual (ER:0642ea974835:known_label_echo:known_label_echo:partition:e3b0c44298). With independent membership unsupported and no warranted structural revision, K6_C0001 is not retained.
